rules.source: User-authorized external-paper failed-entry repair. GitHub Review4579840297 proved file selection incorrectly set generic dirty state after explicit removal. Real native regression also proved successful receipt plus failed read left workbench dirty after recheck because completion callback was missing. Fix original completion/read recovery, not a new submission protocol or blanket clearing. The controlled original request barrier now proves that intermediate state and waits for the actual settlement, not a fixed delay.

New external-paper case proves rejected/unknown/readfail retain failures; final GET-only recheck clears captured failure and stale dirty hint while later failed file remains removable in the completed view; failed-only removal permits leaving but real note edits remain guarded; exactly one actual receipt, original ready object retained and no storage delete. Release then requires exact original failure detach, later failure preservation, and native one-receipt/no-delete/leave-guard assertions.
